in_marathi.name: Lalit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Elegant, Graceful, Skilled
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। 1. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'lalitam', meaning 'skillful'. 2. In Hindu mythology, Lalit is an aspect of Vishnu, representing the power of creativity and artistry. 3. The name is also associated with the god of love, Kamadeva, and is believed to bring beauty and charm.
